body:
My cab entry says the orchard treatment workers brushed off a cloying orchard smell. the horse kicked away its feed before the crossing was barricaded.

My mother put it with the household bills so it would not be thrown away. It was the only part of the week that still had a date.

It may have started elsewhere; none of us saw the beginning. I only know what had reached this place before they closed the road.
title: Cab note — during the hot afternoon
gloss: A personal field trace precedes the visible emergency response.
rival_reading: Responders could have collected the a cloying orchard smell while crossing treated land; the note or objects do not prove the program began the emergency.
